market.question: Will George Russell be the 2026 F1 Drivers' Champion?

assessment.reasoning: Post-Miami GP 2026 standings: Russell is 2nd in drivers championship with 80 points, 20 points behind teammate Antonelli (100). Mercedes leads constructors with 180 pts. Russell is solidly in title fight but trails his own teammate after ~6 of ~24 races. Base rate for trailing #2 in a competitive multi-driver field is ~20-25%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether Russell can outpace Antonelli over the remainder of the season; pace of Mercedes vs Ferrari/McLaren development.
